steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: (Yawn)

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Coming, I'll be right there...

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Hibiscus?

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Good morning... You're up early today. It's barely light out––

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Where's Ebenholz?

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Hm? He's still asleep.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Your eyes are all bloodshot... Did you stay up all night?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: ––Wake him too. Hurry.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: False recovery?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I have no idea what you're trying to say.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Do you really not understand me, or are you just––

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Fine, I'll explain it one more time.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: The reason I came to the Afterglow was to investigate why the Infected people here were suddenly getting better.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: But according to our visits over the last few days, the Infected here in the Afterglow are not getting better, but exhibiting something called a 'false recovery.'

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: In other words, the patient's condition appears to be getting better, but in reality is taking a turn for the worse.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Why would they appear to be improving then if they're getting worse?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Let me explain it another way.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Generally speaking, whenever the body is injured, the best outcome is for it to 'return to its original state.'

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: If it is unable to return to its original state, the body will mobilize its non-damaged parts to cover for the functions lost through the injury, a process we call 'compensation.'

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Right now, most of the Infected in the Afterglow have activated their body's compensation functions, causing them to appear to be in very good shape.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: But inside them, where the eye cannot see, the severity of their Oripathy is rapidly getting worse.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: At the current rate, a certain cohort is about to enter the decompensation stage.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Decompensation?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Once the extent of the damage exceeds the body's maximum ability to compensate, the fragile equilibrium is broken and the patient quickly lapses into the acute exacerbation stage of Oripathy, where their condition deteriorates sharply and becomes life-threatening.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Actually, there are already people starting to enter the acute stage.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: How...?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I get the gist of what you're talking about, but what does this have to do with––

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Wait, are you saying that Kreide is at risk too?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: That isn't the problem. Based on an analysis of our findings so... You and Kreide seem to be the primary factors behind this occurrence.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Kreide and I caused all of this?!

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: That's complete nonsense!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: After analyzing your activities and movements, I've confirmed that you... or maybe something you're carrying, is strongly correlated with the incidence of false recovery.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: For example, the worker in the laundromat beside your residence said the day before that she 'felt especially good.' Her condition worsened dramatically last night, and she was nearly taken to hospice care.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I urge the two of you to cooperate with me. If you have any leads, please let me know right away! This is for the safety of everyone in the Afterglow!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: You can't think of anything at all?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Nothing's coming to mind.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Can the two of you come down to the office with me and let me check something real quick, just in case?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Judging by the markers, one of you is a completely healthy man, and the other is in the stable phase of Oripathy...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: How could this be...?

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: Hibiscus, this time, it's the owner of a music shop behind Afterglow Hall!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: ––How's the situation?

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: Thankfully, he signed an agreement with the hospital in the Cliffy Patio, and has already been picked up.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Another case of false recovery?

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: That's right. Just yesterday afternoon, he reported 'no discomfort whatsoever.'

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: I'll go follow up, just to make sure the hospital doesn't find a way to renege on the agreement.

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: Those two...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'll handle it.

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: Then I'll be off!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I have to ask again, is there anything you can think of?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Every moment is the difference between life and death, so please!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: How about this. Ebenholz, why don't you come with me first? Let's have a chat about this.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Kreide, would you mind waiting a bit inside?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Why'd you drag me out here by myself?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I apologize in advance if this comes off the wrong way, but...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I want you and Kreide to keep some distance from each other. The sooner, the better.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Why are you telling me this, and not him?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Do you suspect that I purposely caused this so-called 'false recovery?'

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: If only it were that simple, I'd be able to hand you straight to the Vyseheim authorities and that'd solve the root of the issue.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: But the incidents of false recovery started before you arrived, and Andante was the one who noticed. Otherwise, I wouldn't have come to the Afterglow, or even to Vyseheim.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Then why did you say that––

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Before I came? What about Kreide?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: The phenomenon of false recovery... began right after he arrived in Vyseheim.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: After he arrived in Vyseheim...? How could that be?!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: It was at roughly the same time Kreide arrived in the Afterglow. The indicators from a portion of the Infected here began to gradually improve.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: But his effect on the Infected was so miniscule at the time that nobody else noticed except the thorough and careful Andante.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: After the two of you met at the registration, Kreide's influence suddenly strengthened.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Based on the reports Andante submitted to the Rhodes Island landship, the situation would've taken at least half a year to deteriorate to its current state with just Kreide alone.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: After you arrived, in just a few days' time... We have the current situation on our hands.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I need you to explain to me what exactly is going on here.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: If you don't have an explanation, I'll need you to put things on hold before the situation spins out of control.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: So, I hope you'll leave the Afterglow, and Vyseheim, as quickly as possible.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: What about the concert?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: The concert? That's what matters to you?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: If the false recovery is caused by some sort of Arts, then your ensemble would amplify that, if anything––

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Wait... Could it be, that's your...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Stop.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I'll be frank. I hate nothing more than being unfairly accused.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: This isn't a problem that can be resolved by respecting your feelings!

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I know!

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: So, give me some time.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: How long do you need?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: If things go smoothly, just a few hours. If not...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: ...I don't know. But I promise I'll be back.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Alright, I'll trust you this once.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: I... I don't agree to this.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Ebenholz worked so hard to perform in the concert, and finally managed to win over Herr Czerny... It'd be a travesty if he just walked away at this point!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: You're missing the bigger picture! We're talking about peoples' lives here!

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Ebenholz?

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Ebenholz, where are you going?

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Ebenholz!

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: You look like you're all out of breath. Did you run the entire way here?

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: I'd urge you not to seek me out in this manner. The risk of being exposed is––

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Exposed?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Things are starting to go pear-shaped, and that's what you're worried about?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I want to ask you something. Does the Resonanz from your so-called Voice of Mundane have any effect on other people?

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: The Resonanz? No.

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: As long as it is not deliberately directed, the Voice of Mundane's Resonanz should not affect others in any way.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Then why did Hibiscus see me and Kreide as the source of the false recoveries?

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: Hibiscus?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: A Rhodes Island operator dispatched to Vyseheim.

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: So Rhodes Island has termed this phenomenon 'false recovery?' A clear and concise description, as you would expect of such professionals.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: You... knew about it after all.

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: If you're talking about the anomalies that have been happening to the Infected in the Afterglow recently, then yes, I do know.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: What exactly is going on?

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: Stated simply, the Voice of Mundane within Kreide is damaged.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Damaged???

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: When you cast Arts, the Voice of Mundane inside you will activate, therefore assisting you. Correct?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Yes, I do hear a faint, shrill melody as I'm casting Arts. How can something like that be damaged?

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: Kreide's Voice of Mundane has always been in an active state, unlike how you are able to turn yours off.

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: In other words, he's been unconsciously casting Arts all around him, with no ability to control it.

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: If you ask him, he'd probably tell you that he's always been able to hear some sort of vague melody in his head.

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: You can understand this phenomenon as 'leakage.'

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: This 'false recovery' is a product of the Voice of Mundane's leakage – indiscriminately increasing the activity of Originium in the surroundings, using the power of Originium to 'heal' the nearby Infected...

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: However, the source of healing energy is taken directly from the Originium within the body of each Infected.

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: Using the Infected themselves as Arts devices, using the Originium inside their bodies to enhance their compensatory functions... This is the 'false recovery' caused by Kreide's Voice of Mundane.

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: Kreide has been in this state for a long, long time, continuously affecting the Infected around him.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: If this has been going on for so long, someone should've figured it out by now!

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: The credit for that goes to you, Herr Ebenholz.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Me?!

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: Resonanz.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Resonanz amplifies the leakage of Kreide's Voice of Mundane, which is causing an explosion in the recent cases of false recovery?

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: That's the situation, yes.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Alright, I see exactly what's going on now.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I hereby withdraw from your plan.

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: Freedom is at your fingertips, and you're going to give it up just like that?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I'm not crazy enough to buy my freedom with the lives of an entire swath of Infected.

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: You've been shaken by that woman from Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: This false recovery is indeed not a good thing, but your concert with Kreide is just a few days away.

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: After a few days, your Voice of Mundane will be removed, and then you'll leave Vyseheim. Nobody will even notice that we're short of a few Infected.

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. If you walk away now, Graf Urtica's shadow will follow you your entire life.

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: Is that what you really want?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: No, but I won't do that either.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Goodbye, Dame Gertrude.

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: Where are you going?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: None of your business.

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: Your footsteps sound rather unsteady. Are you getting a headache?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I already told you...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: It's none of your business!
